dbspec.name: IETAlert
dbspec.source-query: SELECT ALERT_ID as "AlertID", RUN_DATE as "AlertDate", CUSTOMER_ID as "CustomerID", ACCOUNT_ID as "AccountID", ORGUNIT_ID as "OrgunitID", ORGUNIT_CODE as "OrgunitCode", ALERT_STATUS_MAPPED as "AlertStatusMapped", ALERT_STATUS_CODE as "AlertStatusCode" FROM V_SM_IETALERTS WHERE @WHERE@ ORDER BY ALERT_ID
